verdicts.reason: The two candidates are almost pixel-identical and share the same flaws. 'SYMPTOMS' runs right up against the symptom list with almost no gutter. The list wraps into a narrow, cramped column with the awkward break 'Pain in / chest'. The #FLATTENTHECURVE bar is no longer a full-width header and floats as a stubby strip mid-left. The doctor illustration has shrunk to a small, cropped cut-out floating in the corner. The yellow CTA is tiny and squeezed under the image. There is also a large empty band along the bottom. Neither is clearly better: B's headline looks marginally larger, and A has a hair more gap before the list.
